source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 1, Human Capital
source.quote: Our global employees work predominantly full-time and represent at least 140 nationalities, across 28 countries, including approximately 8,900 located in the U.S.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 1, Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we employed approximately 24,400 people globally, with 44% in the Americas, 44% in Asia-Pacific, and 12% in Europe and the Middle East.

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Our corporate headquarters are located in San Jose, California and occupy approximately 0.7 million of owned square feet.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters are located in San Jose, California and occupy approximately 0.7 million of owned square feet.

notes: PayPal's FY2024 10-K gives regional employee shares (Americas 44%, Asia-Pacific 44%, Europe and the Middle East 12% of ~24,400) and a U.S. headcount of ~8,900; no country lists define the regions, and the Americas share includes the U.S. Item 2 gives only aggregate square footage (2.0 million sq ft in the U.S., 1.8 million in other countries) and the San Jose HQ; no other sites, state data or country-level tax data were found in the 10-K. Period: Dec 31, 2024.
